grammar.label: conceding before rebutting — granted, admittedly, true enough
grammar.form: Granted, / Admittedly, / True, / It is fair to say… + concession, then the rebuttal
grammar.meaning: buys credit by agreeing before disagreeing

explanation.en: 'Granted, the sample is small. It is still the only sample anyone has taken.' The concession must be real — a token concession to something nobody claimed makes the rebuttal weaker, not stronger. The rebuttal follows without 'but', because the concession marker has already promised one.
explanation.uz: 'Granted, the sample is small. It is still the only sample anyone has taken.' Tan olish HAQIQIY bo'lishi kerak. Rad javobi 'but' siz keladi, chunki tan olish belgisi uni allaqachon va'da qilgan.

grammar.positive_example: Admittedly the figures are two years old. Nothing newer exists.
grammar.negative_example: Admittedly the figures are two years old, but nothing newer exists, however.

l1_notes.uz: O'zbek tilida 'to'g'ri, lekin…' tuzilmasi bor; ingliz tilida 'granted' dan keyin 'but' ortiqcha.

grammar.label: dismissal markers — be that as it may, for all that, even so
grammar.form: Be that as it may, / For all that, / Even so, / That said, + main claim
grammar.meaning: sets aside what has just been granted and returns to the line of argument

explanation.en: These do the second half of the concession move. 'That said' is the neutral one; 'be that as it may' is formal and slightly impatient; 'for all that' suits a concession that was substantial. Each signals that the writer has heard the objection and is not moved by it — which only works if the objection was stated fairly first.
explanation.uz: Bular tan olishning ikkinchi yarmini bajaradi. 'That said' — neytral; 'be that as it may' — rasmiy va biroz sabrsiz. Har biri e'tirozni eshitganini bildiradi.

grammar.positive_example: The method has been criticised for thirty years. That said, nothing has replaced it.
grammar.negative_example: The method has been criticised for thirty years. That said, but nothing has replaced it.

l1_notes.uz: Bu belgilar qotib qolgan; ularni so'zma-so'z tarjima qilish g'alati chiqadi.
